title: VisitEvent
description: Published by visits-service to Kafka topic visit-events (key = petId) whenever a visit is booked or cancelled. Consumed by notification-alert-service.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event. Consumers use it to skip events they have already processed.

visitId.description: Database id of the visit in visits-service.

petId.description: Id of the pet the visit is for. Also the Kafka message key.

visitType.description: Kind of visit, for example ROUTINE, EMERGENCY or URGENT_CARE. Deliberately not an enum: which types count as urgent is configuration (petclinic.alerts.urgent-types), and an unknown type is classified as ROUTINE.

description.description: Free-text description of the visit. May be empty.

occurredAt.description: When the visit was booked or cancelled: ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC, ending in Z.
